Bengali Festivals 2034 / বাঙালি ক্যালেন্ডার 2034

बंगाली पंजिका मुख्यतः सौर कैलेंडर है, जिसका उपयोग पश्चिम बंगाल, त्रिपुरा, असम और बांग्लादेश के बंगाली समुदाय करते हैं। बंगाली नववर्ष पोइला बैशाख से शुरू होता है। नीचे 2034 के बंगाली त्योहारों की तारीखें हैं।

The Bengali calendar (Panjika, বাঙালি পঞ্জিকা) is a solar calendar used in West Bengal, Tripura, Assam and Bangladesh. The year begins with Boishakh, and the festival season peaks with Durga Puja in autumn. The dates below are the festivals of 2034, worked out for Delhi (IST).

Bengali New Year (Pohela Boishakh) / পহেলা বৈশাখ

Pohela Boishakha falls on 15 April 2034 and begins the Bengali year 1441 (Bangabda). The Bengali year is the Gregorian year minus 593 once Boishakh begins. The day is marked with new clothes, sweets and Halkhata, the opening of new account books.

Durga Puja and the festival season

Durga Puja 2034 runs from Kalparambha and Akal Bodhon on 18 October to Vijayadashami on 22 October. It begins with Mahalaya, followed by Shashthi, Saptami, Ashtami (with Sandhi Puja), Navami and Dashami. Lakshmi Puja is on the next full moon, and Kali Puja falls on the Diwali amavasya, followed by Bhai Phonta.

Popular Bengali festivals

  • Poila Boishakh: the Bengali New Year, in mid-April.
  • Dol Purnima and Saraswati Puja: the spring festivals of colour and learning.
  • Jamai Shashti: honouring sons-in-law in Joishtho.
  • Ratha Jatra and Rakhi Bandhan: the summer festivals.
  • Durga Puja, Lakshmi Puja, Kali Puja and Bhai Phonta: the autumn festival season.
  • Sankranti: the first day of each solar month, such as Poush Sankranti.

Eclipses and the Smarta/ISKCON split of Rama Navami are shown for 2026 only. For other dates, see the Hindu Calendar and Diwali.

Bengali Festivals FAQs

When is Durga Puja in 2034?

Durga Ashtami is on 20 October 2034 and Vijayadashami on 22 October 2034.

When is Pohela Boishakh in 2034?

The Bengali New Year (Pohela Boishakha) is on 15 April 2034.

When is Kali Puja in 2034?

Kali Puja (Dipabali) is on 10 November 2034, with Bhai Phonta on 13 November 2034.

Is the Bengali calendar solar or lunar?

The months are solar, starting at each Sankranti, while Durga Puja, Lakshmi Puja and Dol Purnima follow the lunar tithi.

Dates are for Delhi (IST) and may differ by a day in other cities or traditions. Confirm important festivals with your family pandit.
